Pevznyak Pavel Matveevich (real name Faivel Mordukhovich). In August 1930 - January 1939 - Secretary of the Yakutsk Regional Committee. From July 1937 - Secretary of the Yakutsk City and District Committee of the All-Union Communist Party (Bolsheviks). He was elected a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Yakut ASSR of the 7th and 8th convocations, a member of the Central Executive Committee of the USSR, and a deputy of the Supreme Council of the Yakut ASSR and the USSR of the first convocation. In February 1939, he was relieved of the post of First Secretary of the Regional Committee, arrested on February 5, and sentenced to capital punishment on May 28, which was replaced in May 1941 by 8 years in a correctional labor camp. He died during the construction of the Khandyga-Magadan highway in 1942. He was rehabilitated in 1956. 1930s. Yakutsk.
Photo Fund of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia). No. 14301.
